eventLocation: Indian Naval Training Base at Kalpakkam
eventName: Tree Plantation and Cloth Bag Awareness Programme with the Indian Naval Training Base
eventDescription:
Vidhaigal, a voluntary organisation, together with the Indian Naval Training Base at Kalpakkam, conducted a tree plantation event within the training base premises. The event was successfully organised with the aim of protecting the environment.
Following this, volunteers were divided into groups and went door-to-door distributing cloth bags and explaining to the public the necessity of avoiding plastic.
